2.desc: Blue Flame from Haze x Mudd Brothers is a one-gram hybrid live rosin. Live rosin is a solventless extract pressed from fresh-frozen ice-water hash with only heat and pressure, so it keeps much of the plant's original flavor. Recent lab results put beta-caryophyllene at the top of its terpene profile, bringing a peppery, warm-spice edge, followed by limonene, with a bright, zesty citrus note, and linalool, which adds a soft, floral lavender tone. Together they shape the flavor you taste in every dab. Beyond THC, testing also shows measurable CBG and CBGA, minor cannabinoids that round out the overall profile. Hybrids usually land between sativa and indica and are often described as balanced, happy and easygoing. Being a hybrid, it works for a wide range of plans, from game night and cooking dinner to simply unwinding after work. Use a dab rig, e-rig or concentrate vaporizer, and start with a piece smaller than a grain of rice; lower temperatures bring out more flavor and a smoother hit. Keep the jar closed and store it somewhere cool and dark so the texture and aroma hold up. Everyone responds differently, so start low and go slow, especially if this product is new to you. Concentrates are much stronger than flower. For adults 21 and over. Please consume responsibly and never drive after using cannabis.
